title: OpenFigmaCodeConnectSchema
description: JSON Schema specification for OpenFigma Open Code Connect component mappings

name.description: Design system or component library name

version.description: Semantic version of the code connect mapping configuration

mappings.description: List of component connection mappings from Figma layers to code

target.description: Figma component or layer name pattern to match

importPath.description: Module import path for the production component

propsMapping.description: Key-value mapping of Figma component variant properties to code props

template.description: JSX or HTML template syntax with {{variable}} placeholders
